#   PlatformIO reads THIS file and sets `upload.maximum_size` from the app
#   The board json's own "maximum_size" is therefore overridden and the "size
#   guard" in the PlatformIO/VSCode UI is a straight read of `app0` = 0x800000.
# OTA-RELATED FLASH WRITES ARE GONE WITH otadata:
#   The framework only flashes an empty OTA selector image when the table has a
#   write at 0xe000 => no stray 8 KiB landing inside nvs on every upload.
#   `app0` keeps subtype `ota_0` because that is the framework's own no-OTA
#   convention (noota_ffat.csv does exactly this) and the bootloader boots it
#   directly when no OTA data partition exists.
